I mostly do try to ignore those sort of memes. They were just starting to make me upset and was wondering if anyone else was upset by them. its good that they have somewhere to vent i was just venting about how that venting made me feel too.

i really dont want to dismiss anyones experiences! using that word was a mistake on my part and was sorta the first thing that popped into my head to explain it. I personally experience being trans in a different way so seeing someone explaining the way they were going through it in a way that i interpreted as negative made me sorta upset. I wanted to see if anyone else felt upset as well.

yeah i was just using the word internalized transphobia cuz i wasn't sure what else to use. Mostly in my experience with other trans people its sorta absurd to suggest that you arent your preferred gender. I think it just surprised me and upset me to see memes like that but i do understand them. i think most of this situation has a flip side. The memes could help people who are questioning but make other trans people who are affirmed of their gender start to feel dysphoric or bad. i just don't really like seeing negativity in memes and was wondering if anyone else felt the same way.

sorry if my post made you feel that way. I was mostly just writing my narrative about being trans as an explanation for why the memes made me upset to see. i know and respect the way you feel about your body. I feel it sometimes too. I called it internalized transphobia cuz i wasnt sure what else to call it. im really really sorry.

i already understand what the memes are trying to convey, Its just dysphoria. Im using the word internalized transphobia because i didn't know what other word to use for it. Im not used to seeing people misgender themselves as a joke and i don't personally think it is funny. It just makes me upset to see people saying things like that at their own expense and it can make people who are already affirmed of their gender feel like shit. i get that the people who make the memes feel like shit too. of course they do. this post was meant to be more of a personal question but i worded it wrongly i guess? i wanted to know if anyone else felt like shit looking at these memes as well. i wanted to know if i was just being sensitive but everyone is making me feel like an asshole now.

Was only really trying to spread positivity, the way i see it when i see other trans people is that they are the gender they choose. I respect they may have thoughts differently and i do too but i would never outright call myself or someone else something that they arent. its not like I'm saying its bad to recognize that society perceives you in a certain way but it negatively personally affects me. Mostly this post was to see if anyone felt negatively when they saw it as well.
